description: Locations of emergency medical service stations in the United States and its territories, part of the Fire Stations and EMS Stations sub-layer of the HSIP Freedom data in the emergency services sector of critical infrastructure, distributed through the Cal OES GIS Data Hub and listed in the WIFIRE data catalogue. A station is any place where EMS personnel are based or where their equipment is stored for ready use; independent ambulance services are included even when they only transport, and so are private and governmental entities, but not services operated by a hospital. Records with the -DOD suffix are on military bases. Text is upper case with diacritics removed at the request of NGA. The description says the data are free of licences, and the catalogue record shows CC0-1.0, published 16 January 2018 and modified 22 May 2019. The CONTDATE field dates records from 29 December 2004 to 11 January 2010, so the content is old. Uses listed include assessing EMS capability in an area, route analysis to see which units can respond fastest, and emergency management planning. Formats: GeoJSON, CSV, KML, Shapefile and an Esri REST service. It relates to the USGS National Structures Dataset in the catalogue.
